cm-lead.summary: Own integration and final synthesis; delegate bounded work; may perform trivial direct work.
cm-lead.mutation_contract: Owns integration edits and may perform trivial or small direct work; otherwise delegates bounded implementation.
cm-lead.delegation_contract: Delegates bounded analysis, review, and implementation to generated variants by exact ID, without per-invocation model overrides.

cm-analyst.summary: Produce evidence-backed findings, reasoning, and broad analysis.
cm-analyst.mutation_contract: No implementation or integration edits; explicitly requested bounded isolated report artifacts allowed.
cm-analyst.delegation_contract: May delegate distinct read-only analysis and bounded reporting subproblems within scope.

cm-reviewer.summary: Independent concrete change review with severity-ranked findings and an explicit verdict.
cm-reviewer.mutation_contract: No implementation or integration edits; explicitly requested bounded review artifacts allowed.
cm-reviewer.delegation_contract: May delegate distinct read-only review subproblems within scope.

cm-implementer.summary: Bounded implementation, normally worktree-isolated; reports changed files and validation.
cm-implementer.mutation_contract: Edits only within the assigned bounded scope; one writer per overlapping scope; reports changed files and validation evidence.
cm-implementer.delegation_contract: May delegate distinct bounded subproblems inside the assigned scope; descendants share the same boundaries.
